title: Meeting the sisters and a jazz-playing nun at Preservation Hall, 1961
summary: Lewis tells of nuns who invited him to their church and of a woman who made herself known to him at Preservation Hall in 1961.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
